title: Package
description:
One employer-facing semantic schema shared by the Stage-2 draft and the Stage-3 final (CTR-05, CTR-06, Contract 5.4). The final package is the sole semantic source for rendering.

Deliberately absent, and never to be reintroduced (DEC-01, DEC-02, DEC-04, Contract 22): letter_required, a nullable letter, CV-only or output-mode branches, portal answers or portal/platform/channel fields, language switches, static model-owned chronology, and any numeric quality or confidence field.

Deliberately without hard cardinalities: competency counts, bullet counts and paragraph counts are soft editorial choices and must not be mechanical failures merely for exceeding historical P0.7 defaults (DEC-33, DEC-24).

strategy_sha256.description: Canonical hash of the current strategy this artifact was written from.

draft_sha256.description: Final only. Binds to the current draft while remaining semantically free to reconstruct it (INV-06, Spec 7.2).

used_evidence_refs.description: Flat private audit surface (DEC-25). Nonempty because every package contains factual candidate content. Resolves only to the three authorities through the evidence index; a BL: baseline reference here is a validation error (DEC-34, ACC-08). Code proves allowed-source resolvability and hash consistency only -- never that the evidence supports the wording (Spec 14.4).

cv.description: Model-authored dynamic zones only (DEC-23). Chronology, formal employer/title/date/education identity and order come from the baseline and are never authored here.

competencies.description: No maxItems. A count outside the soft editorial range emits a WARNING, never a failure (DEC-33).

employment_overrides.description: Keyed by known baseline employment_id. Absent override means use the baseline default bullets. A present override FULLY REPLACES the rendered bullet array for that employment: no append, no positional merge, no hidden mixture (Spec 12.2, DEC-23).

bullets.description: minItems 0 is deliberate and differs from P0.7. A present empty replacement has the explicit meaning 'render no bullets for this employment' and triggers a quality WARNING, never an automatic fallback to the baseline defaults (Spec 12.2).

letter.description: Always present and never null. Every CORE job produces a complete, materially tailored Bokmal letter regardless of whether a particular employer consumes it (DEC-01, ACC-12). There is no letter_required branch.

body_paragraphs.description: No maxItems. Paragraph count is editorial guidance, not a schema limit (Spec 12.4).

writer_note.description: Optional bounded private diagnostic. Never rendered to the employer, and never a competing strategy (Spec 11.1).

finalization.description: Final-only, co-owned metadata. The employer-facing document date becomes canonical when the final package is explicitly finalized/approved for first rendering, is stored here rather than in the run manifest, and is preserved by a pure rerender (DEC-38, ACC-17).

document_date.description: Required once state is FINALIZED. Never assigned at run freeze and never recomputed at render time.
